# agentprobe

> You run one command. You learn if AI agents can crawl, read, and act on your site.

agentprobe audits agentic web readiness: llms.txt, robots.txt bot rules, Schema.org JSON-LD, and DOM actionability. You get a 0-100 score and a fix list.

## Install

- [Install and run](/docs.html): npx one-liner plus global install
- [Live audit](/#url): paste a URL, the API runs the 5 engines

## The 5 pillars

- [Bot Accessibility](/docs.html): robots.txt across 15 AI crawlers, sitemap (20 pts)
- [LLM Manifest](/docs.html): /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, token budget (20 pts)
- [Structured Context](/docs.html): JSON-LD, HTML5 landmarks, headings (20 pts)
- [Actionability](/docs.html): markdown negotiation, aria labels, SSR content (20 pts)
- [Protocol Discovery](/docs.html): ai-catalog.json, mcp.json, skills index, x402 (20 pts)

## Docs

- [Full docs](/docs.html): flags, exit codes, CI gate, GitHub Action
- [Source](https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/agentprobe): CLI, engines, reporters
